subject: The secret mistake 90% of users make with AI notes
preview_text: TechCrunch and productivity experts are saying something about Smart Notes that changes everything. You need to see this.
body_paragraphs: I have a confession. I almost didn't send this email. I was reading a TechCrunch review last night, and they called out a specific way people use Smart Notes that is completely backwards. It's the one thing that separates the users who save 5+ hours a week from those who just dabble.

The reviewer said most people treat the AI like a passive recorder. They hit record and zone out. But the real power, according to experts at The Verge and several top productivity coaches, is in the engagement. They said the magic happens when you use the voice-to-text for quick interjections *during* the AI transcription. This creates a hybrid note that's both perfectly accurate and deeply personal. It's the hack that makes you look like the most organized person in the room.

This is why the 'Quick Capture' voice note feature is built right into the live transcription screen. It's not an afterthought. It's the secret weapon. While the AI gets every word, you tap the mic and whisper 'brilliant point' or 'follow up on Q3 budget.' The app weaves your insights directly into the final summary.

Open the app right now and join your next meeting. Let the AI run, but tap that mic icon and add just one thought. See how it transforms your summary. P.S. The TechCrunch piece ended with this line: 'This isn't just note-taking; it's cognitive offloading at its finest.' That's the feeling you're one tap away from.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Try Quick Capture
